## Checklist

- [ ] A changeset (`pnpm changeset`) if a package changes. Not needed for docs-only changes.
- [ ] For a new component: `src/components/[name].stories.tsx` and an entry in `registry/registry.json` (see the Required Checklist in `CLAUDE.md`).
- [ ] `pnpm lint`, `pnpm typecheck` and the tests pass locally.
